_doc: AV Component Registry: Layer AV (Availability) canonical set (opened 2026-07-17). AV1 = the offline CHROME set, shipped as ONE unit (banner + queue + connectivity + device-fingerprint). AV2 = session-timeout.js, a SEPARATE session-hygiene floor keyed to each page's own identity/tenant signals (split 2026-09-30: the all-or-nothing five let a chrome-less ruling exempt a security floor). Health (/health) = Layer A9 100%; loading states = Layer F FF1 100%; DR seeds = seeders/.

components.name: offline CHROME set (banner/queue/connectivity/device-fingerprint) -- session-timeout.js was split out to AV2 on 2026-09-30, see its _split note
components.satisfies: PWA offline resilience on worker tool pages (session hygiene is AV2)
components.need: family minus chrome-less trio; per-page disposition during the wave may add exempts
components.exempt_reason: chrome-less internal surfaces (founder tools / poster / status / reference / the offline shell itself): no offline banner, queue, connectivity widget or device fingerprint by design -- same basis as FCh1/2. Made EXPLICIT on 2026-09-30: six of these sat in the gap carrying ZERO of the set, which the ratchet could not see (its `elif have:` branch reported only PARTIAL pages), so permanent debt read as PASS. Being chrome-less does NOT exempt a page from AV2 session hygiene.

components.name: session-timeout.js (15-min soft prompt + 60-min HARD identity clear)
components.satisfies: shared-device session hygiene: on a shared plant tablet an idle expiry is exactly when the next person picks the tablet up, so the identity keys must be cleared and the person must be TOLD -- announced, named and focused, for someone who cannot see it
components.need: every family page whose CODE (comments stripped) shows an identity or tenant-row signal: wh_last_worker, whWorker(), wh_hive_id, wh_hive_role, or a .from('...') read. Measured 35/42 family pages on 2026-09-30.
components.exempt_reason: none needed: the need-rule is derived from the page's own code, so a surface with no identity and no tenant read is simply not in the need-set (design-system, symbol-gallery, validator-catalog, promo-poster, status, offline-fallback). offline-fallback.html must NEVER carry it: the hard clear redirects to index.html?signin=1, and sending a person to a sign-in page while they are OFFLINE is the one place this guard would do harm.
components.when_to_use: any page that can hold or act on a signed-in identity
components.when_not: a static surface that reads no identity and no tenant row; the offline shell
components._split: Split from AV1 on 2026-09-30 (LXP-AU x assistive-tech walk). AV1 shipped five scripts as ONE all-or-nothing unit, so a single ruling -- 'founder-only, chrome-less by design' -- exempted the four that ARE visible chrome AND the one that is a security floor. agentic-rag-observability.html is the proof case: exempt from all five while reading whWorker()/wh_last_worker and querying .from('agentic_rag_traces') behind a hive gate. session-timeout.js paints nothing until a session ends, so 'chrome-less' was never a reason to omit it.
